section GeneralisationCheck
variable {R : Type*}

-- G1: div_eq_inv_self with the cancellation hypothesis dropped
theorem div_eq_inv_self_nc [DivInvMonoid R] {a b : R} : a / b = b⁻¹ ↔ a = 1 := by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_eq_right]

-- G2: div_left_injective with the cancellation hypothesis dropped
theorem div_left_injective_nc [DivInvMonoid R] {b : R} :
    Function.Injective fun a : R ↦ a / b := by
  intro a₁ a₂ h
  have h' : a₁ * b⁻¹ = a₂ * b⁻¹ := by simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using h
  simpa using (mul_right_cancel (a := a₁) (b := b⁻¹) (c := a₂) h')

-- G3: div_eq_self with DivisionMonoid weakened to DivInvMonoid
theorem div_eq_self_dim [DivInvMonoid R] [IsLeftCancelMul R] {a b : R} :
    a / b = a ↔ b = 1 := by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_eq_left, inv_eq_one]

-- G4: div_eq_self with DivisionMonoid weakened to DivInvOneMonoid
theorem div_eq_self_dio [DivInvOneMonoid R] [IsLeftCancelMul R] {a b : R} :
    a / b = a ↔ b = 1 := by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_eq_left, inv_eq_one]

theorem div_right_injective_dim [DivInvMonoid R] [IsLeftCancelMul R] {b : R} :
    Function.Injective fun x : R ↦ b / x := by
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact fun a a' h ↦ inv_injective (mul_right_injective b h)

-- G6: div_eq_self with the cancellation hypothesis dropped
theorem div_eq_self_nc [DivisionMonoid R] {a b : R} : a / b = a ↔ b = 1 := by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_eq_left, inv_eq_one]

section CrossCancelCheck
variable {R : Type*}

theorem DivisionMonoid.isRightCancelMul_of_isLeftCancelMul_check [DivisionMonoid R]
    [IsLeftCancelMul R] : IsRightCancelMul R where
  mul_right_cancel b x y h := by
    have h : x * b = y * b := h
    have h' : (x * b)⁻¹ = (y * b)⁻¹ := congrArg Inv.inv h
    rw [mul_inv_rev, mul_inv_rev] at h'
    exact inv_injective (mul_left_cancel h')

theorem DivisionMonoid.isLeftCancelMul_of_isRightCancelMul_check [DivisionMonoid R]
    [IsRightCancelMul R] : IsLeftCancelMul R where
  mul_left_cancel b x y h := by
    have h : b * x = b * y := h
    have h' : (b * x)⁻¹ = (b * y)⁻¹ := congrArg Inv.inv h
    rw [mul_inv_rev, mul_inv_rev] at h'
    exact inv_injective (mul_right_cancel h')

-- X1: a left-cancel DivisionMonoid client asks simp for div_left_inj
example [DivisionMonoid R] [IsLeftCancelMul R] {x y z : R} (h : x / z = y / z) : x = y := by
  simpa using h

-- X2: the same client after supplying the derived instance by hand
example [DivisionMonoid R] [IsLeftCancelMul R] {x y z : R} (h : x / z = y / z) : x = y :=
  haveI := DivisionMonoid.isRightCancelMul_of_isLeftCancelMul_check (R := R)
  div_left_injective h

-- X3: div_eq_inv_self for a left-cancel DivisionMonoid, derived from its partner div_eq_self
theorem div_eq_inv_self_of_left [DivisionMonoid R] [IsLeftCancelMul R] {a b : R} :
    a / b = b⁻¹ ↔ a = 1 := by
  rw [← inv_inj, inv_div, inv_inv, div_eq_self]

-- X4: div_eq_self for a right-cancel DivisionMonoid, derived from its partner div_eq_inv_self
theorem div_eq_self_of_right [DivisionMonoid R] [IsRightCancelMul R] {a b : R} :
    a / b = a ↔ b = 1 := by
  rw [← inv_inj, inv_div, div_eq_inv_self]

-- X5: div_right_injective for a right-cancel DivisionMonoid, derived from div_left_injective
theorem div_right_injective_of_right [DivisionMonoid R] [IsRightCancelMul R] {b : R} :
    Function.Injective fun x : R ↦ b / x := fun x y h ↦
  div_left_injective (b := b) (by simpa only [inv_div] using congrArg Inv.inv h)

end CrossCancelCheck

end DivisionMonoid

  cases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty <;> simp [card_le_card_div_right, *]
